summary_en: Full-year dividend forecast raised from 140 yen to 160 yen per share, with 20 yen increase comprising ordinary and special dividends of 80 yen each at mid-term and year-end. Increase reflects refined earnings impact from newly consolidated subsidiary and negative goodwill gain, with implied payout ratio of 33.2% and DOE of 4.7% on adjusted basis.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Consolidated Earnings Forecast for the Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (Upward Revision), Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase), and Recording of Special Gain from Negative Goodwill
translation_en_brief:
KAGA ELECTRONICS revised its full-year dividend forecast from 140 yen to 160 yen per share for the fiscal year ending March 2027. The increase comprises a 20 yen rise split equally between mid-term and year-end payments, each now consisting of 70 yen ordinary dividend and 10 yen special dividend.

The revision reflects the company's acquisition and consolidation of SHINKO SHOJI CO., LTD., which was completed on August 10, 2026, following a tender offer that began May 18, 2026. The company also expects to record a negative goodwill gain of 6 billion yen as special profit related to this acquisition. The initial August 13 earnings guidance had excluded these impacts pending completion of accounting assessments.

The company applied cash allocation principles set out in its Medium-Term Management Plan 2027 (fiscal 2025–2027), which targets a consolidated payout ratio of 30–40% and DOE of 4.0%. On an adjusted basis excluding the negative goodwill gain, the implied payout ratio is 33.2% and DOE is 4.7%, both within target ranges. The dividend increase represents a 20 yen rise from the prior fiscal year dividend of 140 yen.
